text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... I-I'm sorry.
As expected... I'm completely... out of stamina...!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Did you see how hyped the crowd was?
I think everyone just became a fan
of Spe-chan, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It'd be so thrilling if I could completely turn the tables on their expectations~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Anglers are patient, you know.
They keep waiting and waiting for that one chance."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I won't let it end like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mm... We'll definitely face each other again.
We will, for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"By that time, I'll get stronger and stronger...
So much stronger you won't even recognize me!"

—Overcoming the battle against Seiun Sky,
Special Week had grown tremendously.
